settings.interval_seconds.label: Snapshot interval (seconds)
settings.interval_seconds.description: How often the visible workspace is captured. A tile shows the newest capture taken while that workspace was visible.
settings.capture_scale.label: Capture scale
settings.capture_scale.description: grim scale factor. 0.25 captures a 1920x1080 output as 480x270 - cheaper to encode, blurrier in large tiles.
settings.columns.label: Columns
settings.columns.description: Tiles per row in the overview grid.
settings.tile_width.label: Tile width (px)
settings.tile_width.description: Width of one preview tile; the height follows at 16:9.
